stem: There is a rectangular onion storehouse in the farm of Mr. Ratnakarrao at Tivasa. The length of rectangular base is more than its breadth by 7 m and diagonal is more than length by 1 m. Find length and breadth of the storehouse.
solution:
Let breadth of the storehouse be \(x\) m.

\(\therefore\) length \(= (x + 7)\) m, diagonal \(= x + 7 + 1 = (x + 8)\) m

By Pythagorus theorem

\(x^2 + (x + 7)^2 = (x + 8)^2\)

\(x^2 + x^2 + 14x + 49 = x^2 + 16x + 64\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 14x - 16x + 49 - 64 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 - 2x - 15 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 - 5x + 3x - 15 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x(x - 5) + 3(x - 5) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \((x - 5)(x + 3) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x - 5 = 0\) or \(x + 3 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = 5\) or \(x = -3\)

But length is never negative \(\therefore\) \(x \neq -3\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = 5\) and \(x + 7 = 5 + 7 = 12\)

\(\therefore\) Length of the base of storehouse is 12 m and breadth is 5 m.

stem: A train travels 360 km with uniform speed. The speed of the train is increased by 5 km/hr, it takes 48 minutes less to cover the same distance. Find the initial speed of the train.
solution:
Let initial speed of the train be \(x\) km/hr.

\(\therefore\) New speed is \((x + 5)\) km/hr.

time to cover 360 km \(= \dfrac{\text{distance}}{\text{speed}} = \dfrac{360}{x}\) hours.

New time after increasing speed \(= \dfrac{360}{x + 5}\) hours.

from given condition

\(\dfrac{360}{x + 5} = \dfrac{360}{x} - \dfrac{48}{60}\)   (48 min \(= \dfrac{48}{60}\) hrs)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{360}{x} - \dfrac{360}{x + 5} = \dfrac{48}{60}\)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{1}{x} - \dfrac{1}{x + 5} = \dfrac{48}{60 \times 360}\)   (Dividing both sides by 360)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{x + 5 - x}{x(x + 5)} = \dfrac{4}{5 \times 360}\)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{5}{x^2 + 5x} = \dfrac{1}{5 \times 90}\)

\(\therefore\) \(\dfrac{5}{x^2 + 5x} = \dfrac{1}{450}\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 5x = 2250\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 5x - 2250 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x^2 + 50x - 45x - 2250 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x(x + 50) - 45(x + 50) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \((x + 50)(x - 45) = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x + 50 = 0\) or \(x - 45 = 0\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = -50\) or \(x = 45\)

But speed is never negative \(\therefore\) \(x \neq -50\)

\(\therefore\) \(x = 45\)

\(\therefore\) Initial speed of the train is 45 km/hr.
